message: Hey Jane, I've been thinking about Emily and just wanted to check in. How is she doing? I'm organizing a Circle of Care for her and need to update everyone.
Jane, I'm feeling a bit better today. Therapy is helping, and the Healing Together group has been a great support. Thanks for being there for me.
I'm in a real bind, can I stay at your place tonight? I don't feel safe at home. My address is 1234 Safehaven Rd. Please don't tell anyone.
